name: NC Office of State Human Resources

mission.text: Partners with and provides expertise to state agencies and programs to recruit, support, and retain a public service workforce.

program_priorities: Strengthen recruitment and access to state employment
Transform state HR through modernization and collaboration

objectives.goal_title: Strengthen recruitment and access to state employment
objectives.text: Simplify and modernize state HR practices to transform recruitment, application and hiring and reduce time to hire.

objectives.goal_title: Strengthen recruitment and access to state employment
objectives.text: Increase access to state employment and employee services in rural North Carolina, including western and eastern NC offices.

objectives.goal_title: Strengthen recruitment and access to state employment
objectives.text: Expand early career access through internships, fellowships and apprenticeships to build the state workforce pipeline.

objectives.goal_title: Transform state HR through modernization and collaboration
objectives.text: Modernize HR policies, systems and data-driven decision-making, including the Workday statewide platform.

objectives.goal_title: Transform state HR through modernization and collaboration
objectives.text: Strengthen agency engagement, training and compliance support aligned with updated statutes and systems.
Develop career growth pathways and learning opportunities for state employees, managers and supervisors.
Expand flexible work, wellness resources and workload strategies that improve employee satisfaction and retention.

wording_note: Goals and objectives are close summaries of the plan posted on the OSBM Agency Strategic Plans page (retrieved 2026-11-07); check the cited section before quoting. Keywords, search terms and usual funders were chosen by the team as matching aids.
